$comment: Project profile for the canon-shipped harness (tools/harness in the sza plugin), written 2026-10-29 when the project joined the task-flow ledger (owner order: every project in the ledger, worked by the portfolio runner). Only what differs from the canon defaults is here. Ticket files are DEV/plan/<id>_<slug>.md; a file written there without a ledger row is registered by the portfolio queue sync (TASK-FLOW rule 65). The probe gates run on every BlockNeedUserTest entry and exit whatever probes.enabled says (measured 2026-10-29, E0117), so probes.scanRoots names this repo's code trees instead of the canon default src/, and a ticket with no probe is excused in paths.probeBaseline with its reason.
